description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller class named ReferenceController that handles various HTTP requests related to reference data such as provinces, countries, zones, and credit card date info. It interacts with services to retrieve geographical and language data and provides JSON responses for use in web UI components.

classes.name: ReferenceController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing reference data endpoints for countries, provinces, zones, and credit card date info.

methods.name: getProvinces
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve a list of provinces (zones) for a specified country code and language, returning data as JSON.

methods.name: countryName
methods.description: Returns the display name of a country based on its code, considering the request's language context.

methods.name: zoneName
methods.description: Provides the name of a zone given its code, respecting the request's language context.

methods.name: getCreditCardDates
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of upcoming years (next 10), used for credit card expiration date selection.

methods.name: getMonthsOfYear
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of months (01 through 12) for credit card expiration date selections.
